notes.title: 2025-03-13 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
We have updated [Freezing What If...] with several improvements.

1. Bug Fixes
 - Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when an invincible enemy died from bleeding or burns.
 - Fixed typos.
 - Minor bug fixes.

2. New Features & Improvements

 1) Added a new feature: Instant Search System.

 2) Added a new feature: Training Center.
 - Available through research.

 3) Reduced resource requirements and time for research and development.
 - Lowered research points required for Future Food.
 - Lowered research points required for Resource Recycling 3.
 - Reduced research time for Large Nova 1.
 - Reduced research time for Large Nova 2.
 - Lowered resource cost for Nova Signal Interpretation Equipment research.
 - Lowered resource cost for Nova Gate research.

4) Reduced resource requirements for construction facilities.
 - Reduced resource consumption (Primonium) for all facilities at level 5.
 - Lowered overall resource consumption for barrier facilities.

5) Reduced experience required for Limiter’s growth.

6) Added new message effects for bad endings.

7) Improved New Game+ features.
 - Retained completed research progress.
 - Allowed direct access to the final stage from the second playthrough onward.

8) Original Author's Permission Notice

We will continue to improve [Freezing What If...] to enhance your experience!

notes.title: 2025-02-20 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Several improvements have been updated for [Freezing What If...].

1. Bug Fixes
- Typographical errors corrected
- Minor bugs fixed
- Adjusted character creation to recognize single-character names

2. New Features & Improvements
1) Added Character Information Display in World Screen Team Setup

2) Stage Information Improvements
- [u][b]Added high-probability reward item indicators in stage search rewards.
Each region has specific items that can be acquired with a higher probability, marked with a star icon to the left of the item name.[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45433271/ff4c0a89df42c9587c4705ddaec90413715112d4.png[/img]
- Added boss level display in stage information during searches.
- Added details regarding obtaining "Memory Fragments" in stage reward information.

3) Currency Balance Adjustments
Previously, Steel currency was only given in regional battles. Now, it is also provided as a reward in general searches, allowing for faster progression.
- Additional Steel rewards have been added for regional search battles.

We will continue improving [Freezing What If...] to provide a better experience.

Thank you!

notes.title: 2025-02-12 Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Several improvements have been updated for [Freezing What If...]

1. Bug Fixes
 - Typographical errors corrected
 - Minor bugs fixed

2. New Features and Improvements
 1) Added research-related information to the world screen

 2) Improved battle UI : Enhanced display of active characters in the turn order panel

 3) Added a standby screen for battles against hidden Pandora

 4) Adjusted resource balance
 To allow for faster Pandora growth, we have adjusted the resource balance:

 - Increased the amount of initial resources given
 - Increased the number of Pandora Memory Fragments obtained from stage rewards (5 → 10)
 - Increased overall rewards of steel and items for winning regional battles
 - Increased overall experience points earned from stage rewards
 - Increased overall item acquisition from stage rewards
 - Increased intelligence provided when constructing espionage facilities

We will continue to improve [Freezing What If...]!

Thank you!
